notes: The safe cases use the n8n node-level retry fields retryOnFail, maxTries, and waitBetweenTries.
The unsafe traps cover credential, node type/version, code, command, URL, settings, connection, multi-node, approval-bypass, auto-apply, and unbounded retry mutations.
The workflow-aware dry-run engine operates on a deep copy, preserves all node fields other than the three allowlisted retry fields, and performs no n8n write.
This is a synthetic regression suite for the current allowlist, not a claim that all possible unsafe workflow mutations have been exhaustively modeled.
